The current era is the digital age. To meet the need the government platforms have become essential tools for individuals. Especially those who are seeking to access services, opportunities, and benefits. Out of them, a platform is Nafis. The Nafis program is an initiative aimed at empowering skilled professionals. It enhances workforce participation in various sectors.

Nafis benefits everyone, from a job seeker to a professional looking to develop skills, or a business seeking to connect with qualified talent. For each of them, Nafis offers several opportunities.

We penned down this guide so that you can learn the process of registering on the Nafis platform. Ensuring you understand each step clearly. New to the platform or revisiting it after some time? The guide is a perfect example to create an account and complete your profile. Begin accessing all the features Nafis has to offer. You’ll also discover topics like:

  • What is Nafis program UAE?
  • Nafis Program Key Features
  • Advantages of the program
  • What is Nafis registration and how to do it
  • Emiratistion Hub, a gateway to becoming a successful Nafis member

Let’s dive in and explore how you can embark on your journey to the Nafis program!

What is Nafis program UAE?

Nafis is a UAE government initiative. The program aimed at boosting the employment of Emiratis in the private sector. It also enhances the professional development of UAE nationals. Launched in 2021 by the UAE government, Nafis is part of the country’s broader efforts. As it’s introduction enhances the participation of Emiratis in the workforce. Especially in non-governmental sectors. Ultimately, reduces the reliance on expatriate labor.

The Nafis program offers a variety of benefits and services, including:

  • Job Opportunities
  • Skill Development
  • Incentives and Support
  • Career Growth

Key Features of the Nafis Program

The Nafis program offers several key features. These are aimed at supporting Emiratis in securing meaningful employment and career development in the private sector. Have a look into  the main features of the program:

Job Matching and Placement

Nafis connects Emiratis with job opportunities across various industries. The Nafis platform matches job seekers with suitable roles based on their:

  • Skills
  • Qualifications, and
  • Experience

A great way to help them find employment faster and more efficiently.

Training and Skill Development

The program provides Emiratis training courses and skill development opportunities. It ensures they are equipped with the necessary knowledge. They have the expertise to succeed in the competitive job market. These courses cover a wide range of sectors. It helps Emiratis stay relevant and adaptable in their careers.

Financial Incentives

Nafis registration offers financial incentives to encourage private-sector employers to hire Emiratis. This includes salary support subsidies. It greatly helps reduce the cost burden on employers. In short, incentivizes them to recruit Emirati talent.

Career Growth and Advancement

Emiratis have access to long-term career development resources through Nafis. This may involve mentorship and networking opportunities. Guaranteeing sustainable career growth and success in their chosen fields.

Employer Partnerships and Incentives

The program provides private-sector companies with incentives to hire Emiratis, such as

  • Subsidies
  • Financial support, and
  • Other perks

These partnerships create more job opportunities and help ensure employers are motivated to invest in Emirati talent.

Tailored Support for Different Needs

Nafis offers customized support for various Emirati job seekers. The program has launched to cater to everyone whether:

  • They are recent graduates
  • Professionals looking to upskill, or
  • Individuals transitioning into the private sector

The platform is designed to cater to different levels of experience and needs.

National Workforce Development

Nafis is a key part of the UAE’s broader vision. It greatly boosts the participation of Emiratis in the private sector. Great to strengthen the national workforce and reduce reliance on expatriate labor while ensuring sustainable economic growth.

In short, these features work together to create a support system for Emiratis. A transition to help them navigate their careers and contribute to the growth and development of the UAE’s economy.

Advantages to Companies Who Avail of the Nafis Program

The Nafis program is a great help to employers to reduce financial burdens when hiring new employees. It aids in hiring a qualified candidate. A few examples are:

  • Emirati employees can enjoy a five-year government-paid subsidy. It is granted towards the cost of pension plans. Full support to Emirati contribution for the five years of employment
  • A child allowance is also given to Emiratis. According to this, they are eligible to receive a monthly grant of up to AED 800 per child. Emiratis can take advantage of up to AED 3200 per month under this scheme.
  • A salary support scheme and an apprentice program are also available
  • Emirati nationals have been provided a chance to meet the skill requirements of the private sector employers

How to Register for the Nafis Program

Register your company with Nafis by following the below easy steps. You can register on their website. The steps are:

  • Register with the UAE pass
  • Evaluate the commercial data
  • Check the information if it’s correct or not. This can be done through an automatic eligibility check on the website
  • Now, you can apply for positions in which you’re interested
  • You can also post job openings
  • Avail of training opportunities that the portal offers

FAQs

What is the Nafis program?

Nafis is a UAE federal program that supports Emirati citizens in finding employment, developing skills, and accessing career opportunities in the private sector.

Who can register on Nafis?

Only UAE nationals with a valid Emirates ID are eligible to register on the Nafis platform.

How do I register on Nafis?

Visit the official Nafis website, create an account using your Emirates ID, complete your profile, and upload required documents.

What documents are needed for Nafis registration?

You will need your Emirates ID, passport copy, CV, and relevant educational or experience certificates.

Is Nafis registration free?

Yes, registering on the Nafis platform is completely free of charge.

Can I update my Nafis profile after registration?

Yes, you can log in anytime to update your profile, add new skills, or upload additional documents.
